notes: Coverage targets are research goals, not quotas. Genuine asymmetries remain visible and require coverage_exception rather than reclassification.

Political orientation and radicality require attributed provenance; constitutional position (for example unionist or pro-independence) is recorded separately and is not mapped automatically onto the left-right axis.
Party press is an independent dimension and is not a political group.
Sunday products are modeled as outlets/editions of the same source brand where applicable.
coverage_policy_notes: Targets are research goals, not quotas. Under-covered groups require a documented coverage_exception; titles are never reclassified to fill a quota.
